documentation: Copy this file to the Signal K plugin data directory as lifecycle-rules.json. It is read when the plugin starts; saving the Signal K Plugin Config reloads the plugin, so changed rules then become active without a separate server restart. A matching endWhen closes only the current local lifecycle; the next matching notification starts a new occurrenceId. Use source and path to limit custom producer cases. The built-in anchor boundary uses the authoritative inactive navigation.anchor.state input (off or removed value) and does not require a rule here.
